paginationFilterOrder.pagination: No pagination, cursor, page size, limit, offset or query filters accepted; any query (even empty ?) refuses, except explicit /api/me HEAD does not parse it.
paginationFilterOrder.filterOrder: Members: all users ORDER BY lower(email),id LIMIT 10001, >10000 fails before filtering; omit disabled/no-access users. Include active access even without memberships. memberships iterate catalog order, only nonarchived companies where caller currently owner and target latest grant exists. twoFactorEnabled null SQL becomes false; accessReady=emailVerified && twoFactorEnabled. No total/count/cursor envelope.

revisionConfirmationCapabilities.revision: No revision/ETag/If-Match/confirm/idempotency field interpreted; no client concurrency promise.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.authorization: Single Host exactly configured authority; optional Origin on reads must exactly match configured origin; mandatory exact Origin on POST. Sec-Fetch-Site absent or exactly same-origin/same-site/none. Duplicate these headers fail one(). Human Authorization or x-rentemester-service-key refused 401; single cookie header selected by one(), native profile/HMAC verification then current same-writer verified-email/MFA/session/access authority. Secure vs Development cookie names are not interchangeable; no bearer/session output. WorkspaceMembersRead and WorkspaceMembersManage both require workspace_owner; member is not sufficient. Reads filter company-scoped visibility to companies where caller currently has owner membership. Issue and company grant/revoke also require caller CompanyAdmin (owner) and live nonarchived registered company. Cancel requires invitation visible in filtered list. Business writes require transfer mode active. Current authority is recomputed under immediate control transaction, not granted by prior /api/me.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.concurrency: Caller/owner lifetime retained across native operation; blocking task keeps permit if HTTP request is cancelled. Transport failure is not rollback evidence.

retry.naturalDedup: Not applicable: transactional human snapshot read, no provider effects or keyed mutation.
retry.readBack: Repeat explicit GET /api/workspace/members only with current authenticated workspace_owner; invitationId or members.userId + memberships.companySlug identify rows. Filters/archival/access changes and global row-bound failure mean absence is not durable proof of cancellation, disable, or revoke. GET /api/auth/get-session and GET /api/me describe current caller, not target mutation outcome; neither grants later authority.
retry.unresolvedProvider: Not applicable: no external provider delivery.

installation.condition: Configured native Backend identity merged with product and setup routers; without backend selected operations are not installed in public-only manifest. /api/me exists whenever AuthHandlers installed; optional human/service callbacks may individually be absent (GET404; HEAD405).
installation.profile: Native dedicated-linux or local-user-macos admitted owner; Secure HTTPS vs Development loopback cookie profile. No Bun auth fallback; current configured backend supplies human and service context handlers.

query.unknownOrDuplicate: Rejected as any query; /api/me HEAD does not parse query.

headers.humanGuard: Single Host exactly configured authority; optional Origin on reads must exactly match configured origin; mandatory exact Origin on POST. Sec-Fetch-Site absent or exactly same-origin/same-site/none. Duplicate these headers fail one(). Human Authorization or x-rentemester-service-key refused 401; single cookie header selected by one(), native profile/HMAC verification then current same-writer verified-email/MFA/session/access authority. Secure vs Development cookie names are not interchangeable; no bearer/session output.

input.contentType: Exactly application/json, case-insensitive; charset parameter is rejected; content-encoding presence rejects 400.
input.semanticValidation: Schema describes valid semantic input; strings outside role/action/token constraints deserialize but then refuse. Full body is parsed before try-acquire worker permit. No confirm, revision or idempotency-key field; unknown JSON fields rejected.
input.admission: Product semaphore capacity 8, try-acquire =>503 busy; owner mutex, catalog and continuously admitted owner. No HTTP rate limiter in this product adapter; do not borrow native auth per-peer rate. Public claim performs origin proof without reading cookie and takes same product permit.

variants.when: Current native transaction succeeds.
Host/Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site mismatch or duplicates; public claim also refuses Authorization or service header here.
Cookie proof failed or forbidden Authorization/service header; companies service branch forbids cookie/authorization or invalid service key.
Any query; mutation encoding/content-type/body JSON/unknown/duplicate fields or action shape rejected.
Product worker permit unavailable; workspace adapters parse POST before acquiring permit.
Body read fails or exceeds 32768 bytes.
OutcomeUnknown before other mappings; owner/catalog/delivery-lock/host/join failure. Not a rollback assertion.
Native invalid_credentials or access_denied after transaction/current authority check.
Committed identity/invitation intent but mail handoff not confirmed.
Other native NotCommitted failure preserves exact f.error.code with errors=[code], not request_refused.

refusal.headersPolicy: No Set-Cookie, no credential clearing or revocation by adapter. Product post-result workspace responses add referrer-policy:no-referrer; early parsing/proof/busy returns do not. Product responses cache-control:no-store. Native responses also no-referrer/nosniff.

negotiation.absent: All three negotiation headers absent: legacy major-1 compatibility. No auth bypass.
negotiation.present: Exactly one each: x-rentemester-protocol=1, x-rentemester-manifest=current connected manifestId, x-rentemester-wire-profile in legacy-react-v1/rust-http-v1, exact method/path present. Partial/duplicate/invalid/stale values refuse before endpoint.

failure.when: Negotiation rejected before endpoint; no endpoint effects.

parseProtocol.jsonParsing: Serde struct inputs reject unknown fields and duplicate known fields, wrong types, missing required fields, malformed JSON and trailing nonwhitespace. Option<String> accepts missing or null; fields unused by chosen action must be absent or null. No duplicate-query resolution: any query, including empty ?, rejected.

Company adapter admin requires nonarchived company even on revoke despite storage allowing archived revocation.

retry.naturalDedup: Same userId and desired current workspace role/disabled state is a storage no-op. No client dedup key.
retry.readBack: GET /api/workspace/members by userId under current workspace_owner authority. Disable removes active row from list, appends session invalidation and deletes user sessions only on state change. Absence alone does not prove disable (filter/permissions/read failure). Re-check current authority and last-owner protections; no blind replay after pending/unknown outcome.
